steps.title: Open the Structure page
steps.narration: Let's open the Structure page — home to real stock price history and the support-and-resistance levels built from it, all sourced straight from Yahoo Finance with no sign-up, no API key, and no fee.
steps.point_out: A 'Fetch from Yahoo Finance' panel sits at the top, and a simpler, read-only 'Load' form sits just below it.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its S/R levels and confluence zones.

steps.title: Preview the Yahoo Finance fetch panel
steps.narration: This top panel is where you'd request brand-new history from Yahoo Finance for any symbol — type a ticker, like AAPL, choose one of six real timeframes (weekly down to 1-minute, including an honestly-computed 4-hour view), pick a date range, and fetch with one click.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field in the Fetch panel now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Look up AAPL's saved history
steps.narration: AAPL's history is already saved from an earlier fetch, so let's pull it up using the simpler, read-only Load form just below.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field in the Load form now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Set the as-of time
steps.narration: Enter a point in time to check its levels as of.
steps.point_out: The As-of field is filled in.

steps.title: See the real chart and its levels
steps.narration: Click Load, and the app draws a real candlestick chart with support-and-resistance levels, plus a confluence-zone breakdown — all computed from real, previously-fetched Yahoo Finance data.
steps.point_out: A real candlestick chart appears with dashed support-and-resistance lines, and a 'Confluence zones' list below shows Class A/B/C zones with scores.

steps.title: See exactly where the data came from
steps.narration: A small badge above the chart names the real source of this data, so where the numbers came from is never a mystery.
steps.point_out: A dark chip reading 'feed' next to 'Yahoo Finance' in bold sits cleanly above the chart, fully legible with nothing overlapping it.

steps.title: Ask for the same window again
steps.narration: Ask for the same window again, and it comes right back instantly — this history is already safely stored, so there's nothing new to fetch.
steps.point_out: The identical chart and confluence zones reappear immediately.
